final: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.state_county_province AS s, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.customer_id) AS n FROM Customers cu JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.state_county_province), sh AS (SELECT s, n, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM c) AS share FROM c), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM sh) SELECT SUM(sh.n) AS combined_count, AVG(sh.share) AS avg_share, AVG(sh.share - av.a) AS avg_excess FROM sh, av WHERE sh.share > av.a
